data.xText: MrBeast started GTA 6 with $0 and one goal: buy the most expensive car in the game within 100 hours. The video hit 22M views in its first day. How the money moved: > first payday: $20 from a guy reading on the street > hour 5, first gas station: $800. The clerk passed out mid-robbery > hour 16: $17,000 > hour 28: about $20,000 > after hour 47: a getaway with $31,000 > then $87,000, then $110,000 by the end > registering the stolen car alone: $66,250. The underglow: $500 Rockstar let them play before launch. 13 years of waiting, and the biggest GTA 6 video on YouTube is a money ladder. @grok what's the fastest legit way to $100K in GTA 6 right now?
